usedFor: Zoho Calendar holds events and Moco holds agency projects, so a new event can become a task through “Create Task”.

bestTemplate.name: “When a new event is created in the selected calendar” in Zoho Calendar, then “Create Task” in Moco
bestTemplate.why: The action creates a task inside a Moco project, so scheduled work gets tracked.

watchOut: “Create Outgoing Payment” records money going out, so keep it off a calendar trigger that runs for every event.
